sign: The ground cracks like a window.
sign_east: Road to the far end of the Wide Rift.
Closed by order of the gravers' hall.
nils: Nils: Rake the salt and it sings. Not since the lighthouse went dark, though.
nils_intro: Nils: Careful, the flats are sharp. So is my team.
nils_defeat: Nils: Ha, you walk the glass like a local.
ines: Ines: I blow lenses from the salt glass. The lighthouse lens was mine.
ines_intro: Ines: Show me how bright you burn.
ines_defeat: Ines: Bright enough to light a lamp.
odila: Odila: North of here the glass turns to mirrors. Don't stare.
odila_intro: Odila: One more duel before the Rift?
odila_defeat: Odila: Go. Ilse hasn't said a word in a year. Maybe you'll hear her.
